items.title: Iran war live: Tehran prepares conditions to open Strait of Hormuz
items.description: Iran says it is preparing to draft conditions to open the Strait of Hormuz following mediator requests.

items.title: The man behind Srebrenica: Ratko Mladic dies at 84
items.description: For many, Ratko Mladic represented the horrors of the Bosnian War. He was convicted of genocide for the Srebrenica massacre and of other war crimes. Now he has died in detention at The Hague.

items.title: In Sudan’s civil war, both sides target journalists
items.description: Local journalists reporting on Sudan’s civil war and humanitarian crisis there are facing a campaign of intimidation by rival military forces.

items.title: Convicted Bosnian Serb war criminal Mladić dies aged 84
items.description: He was jailed for life in 2017 for genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity during the wars in the ex-Yugoslavia in 1992-95.

items.title: Ukrainian Drone Spots SOS, Sparking 3-Day Rescue From Frontline Village
items.description: After a Ukrainian drone operator spotted an SOS sign outside a destroyed home in the Donetsk region, a three-day rescue mission was launched to save a couple who were the last remaining residents of their frontline village. items.title: Ratko Mladic, Bosnian-Serb general convicted of genocide, dies age 84
items.description: A key military architect of the 'Greater Serbia' project, Mladic was convicted in 2017 of 'genocide, crimes against humanity and war crimes' during the war in Bosnia and Herzegovina by judges at the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia. Imprisoned in The Hague, he died on August 27.

items.title: Ratko Mladic, former general convicted of Bosnia genocide, dies
items.description: Ratko ⁠Mladic, convicted of genocide for orchestrating ​the 1995 massacre of at least 8,000 Muslims in a U.N.-designated "safe area" of Bosnia, Europe's worst atrocity since World War Two, died on Thursday in U.N. custody. France 24's correspondent in Belgrade, Laurent Rouy, has the latest.

items.title: Russian Forces Inching Closer to Slovyansk in Eastern Ukraine’s Donetsk Region, Gerasimov Says
items.description: Chief of the General Staff Valery Gerasimov said Russian troops are positioned just 4 kilometers from the eastern outskirts of Slovyansk.

items.title: Ratko Mladic, ex-Bosnian Serb warlord who oversaw atrocities, has died at 84
items.description: Ratko Mladic was one of the most notorious figures of a war that killed over 100,000 people in the 1990s. He commanded his troops to "scorch the brains" of the Bosnian Muslims and boasted of being a "Serbian God."

items.title: Russia Preparing New Mobilization Wave of 600,000, Ukrainian Intelligence Says
items.description: Ukraine’s intelligence agencies say Russia is preparing a new mobilization wave that could bring 600,000 additional troops into the war effort across 2026–2027. Kyiv says Moscow is tightening recruitment and coercive measures as battlefield losses rise and contract recruitment slows.
